The snapshot includes these 65 public source files, the parent copy manifest and runner/plan metadata. Engine code and the qualified host remain unchanged.

The evidence runner records exact subprocess argument vectors, scoped environment overrides, stdout, stderr, exit status, source hashes and predecessor receipts. It reuses the established qualification runner's snapshot, subprocess, compiled-input and JUnit receipt pattern; it is orchestration only and implements no recipe or test assertion replacement. Each stage requires its predecessor to pass. Lint checks XML configuration, engine/fixture identities and source whitespace. Compilation uses offline real cached OpenRewrite 8.17.1/JUnit 5.10.2 with Java 21, -Xlint:all and -Werror. Actual compiler input lists must contain only the four public engine files and public host test owner.

Each SDK test gate must report five tests with zero failures/errors/skips, unchanged compiled inputs, the exact emitted fixture postimage, the exact 14 SDK binding rows, and all applicable positive/fixed-point/reversed-input/refusal proof groups. The Java lane additionally requires wrong-representation refusal. Runtime output goes to the public mirror's ignored target directory; raw evidence stays here. No output is received into product sources.

That canonical construction inventory is neither in the 61-copy manifest nor required by the host. The authoritative public source manifest and SDK bindings are used. No qualification gate or source repair resulted from that exploratory read.

Stop after a failed gate, preserve its raw evidence and report to parent before any source repair. Exclude ignored Maven output from publication. This plan precedes the new evidence runner; no Java helper, engine or test source is created.
